audit_metadata.task: External Spectroscopic Catalog Availability & Coverage Audit
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Independent Scientific Validation Lead & Software Integrity Auditor

gaia_dr3_xp.catalog_name: ESA Gaia DR3 BP/RP Low-Resolution Spectra (XP)
gaia_dr3_xp.sky_coverage: All-Sky (~220 million sources with XP spectra)
gaia_dr3_xp.spherex_overlap: Band 1 only (0.75-1.05 um; Channels 0-13). Zero coverage for Bands 2-6 (1.1-5.0 um)
gaia_dr3_xp.p0008_limiting_factor: G < 17.65 publication threshold for continuous XP coefficients
gaia_dr3_xp.crossmatch_method: Native 1-to-1 exact key match on source_id (zero positional ambiguity)
gaia_dr3_xp.infrared_normality_status: PROXY_ONLY (Optical normal stars can possess warm dust / IR excess)
gaia_dr3_xp.reconstruction_dependency: Requires gaiaxpy Python package (currently NOT installed in workspace)

sdss_optical_boss.catalog_name: Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS DR17 / DR18 BOSS Spectrograph)
sdss_optical_boss.sky_coverage: North Galactic Cap (|b| > 30 deg) and Stripe 82; zero coverage below Dec -15 deg
sdss_optical_boss.spherex_overlap: Band 1 only (0.75-1.04 um). Zero coverage for Bands 2-6
sdss_optical_boss.p0008_limiting_factor: Sparse ancillary plate coverage in Dec +5 to +10 deg region (outside Stripe 82)
sdss_optical_boss.crossmatch_method: Astrometric cone search (1.5 arcsec radius) with proper motion propagation from J2000
sdss_optical_boss.p0002_coverage_status: ZERO_COVERAGE (Dec -30 deg is below Apache Point horizon)

sdss_apogee_2.sky_coverage: Targeted pencil-beam fields in Northern and Southern hemispheres
sdss_apogee_2.p0008_limiting_factor: Sparse pencil-beam plate geometry; red-giant target selection bias
sdss_apogee_2.crossmatch_method: 2MASS ID match or 1.5 arcsec cone search
sdss_apogee_2.infrared_normality_status: PROXY_ONLY (Covers H-band only; no 3-5 um coverage)

lamost_lrs.sky_coverage: Northern sky observable from Xinglong (-10 deg < Dec < +60 deg)
lamost_lrs.p0008_limiting_factor: Dec +5 to +10 deg accessible; moderate stellar survey coverage
lamost_lrs.crossmatch_method: Astrometric cone search (1.5 arcsec radius) with proper motion propagation
lamost_lrs.infrared_normality_status: PROXY_ONLY (Overlaps only 8 SPHEREx channels; ends at 0.90 um)
lamost_lrs.p0002_coverage_status: ZERO_COVERAGE (Dec -30 deg is below LAMOST horizon)

allwise_photometric_sidecar.spherex_overlap: Direct overlap with SPHEREx Band 4 (W1 3.4 um) and Band 6 (W2 4.6 um)
allwise_photometric_sidecar.infrared_normality_status: SUITABLE (Directly flags 3-5 um circumstellar dust, YSOs, and AGN)

environment_and_access_audit.network_sandbox_status: RESTRICTED (DNS getaddrinfo failed on all external endpoints in standard sandbox mode)

recommendations_for_task_4_2b.primary_rationale: 100% of P0008 calibration sources natively possess Gaia DR3 64-bit source_id values in the catalog table, eliminating all astrometric cone search ambiguity and proper motion propagation uncertainty. ~40-45% of P0008 sources are expected to have published continuous/sampled XP spectra, and nearly 100% have Apsis astrophysical parameters (Teff, logg, Av).
recommendations_for_task_4_2b.secondary_recommendation: Integrate an ALLWISE mid-infrared color-excess sidecar (W1 - W2) to provide the only direct physical mid-infrared normality check for circumstellar dust, debris disks, and late-type excesses across SPHEREx Bands 4-6.
recommendations_for_task_4_2b.prerequisite_engineering_step: Install gaiaxpy and astroquery in the python environment, and execute remote queries with user-authorized sandbox bypass or pre-staged offline TAP extracts.
